title: s500-generic-45: Letter and word selective SEEG responses in the ventral occipito-temporal cortex, fast periodic visual stimulation (Lochy et al., 2018) (derivative)
description: Stereo-EEG (intracerebral) recordings from 37 patients with refractory epilepsy who viewed fast periodic visual stimulation sequences. Words appeared at 2 Hz among pseudofonts, nonwords, or pseudowords presented at 10 Hz, which allowed letter- and word-selective responses in the left ventral occipito-temporal cortex to be measured at 2 Hz and its harmonics. This derivative release contains the authors' Letswave files, low-pass filtered at 40 Hz and cut into sequences, repackaged in BIDS with electrode coordinates in Talairach and MNI space.
methods_description: SEEG was recorded with Micromed systems from patients at the University Hospital of Nancy during fast periodic visual stimulation at 10 Hz, with a word at every fifth item (2 Hz). The authors preprocessed the data in Letswave 5 with a 40 Hz Butterworth low-pass filter (order 4). Each sequence was cut from 2 s after onset to about 68 s, an integer number of 2 Hz cycles, and sequences of one condition were merged into one file. The files were repackaged into BrainVision format with events and electrode coordinates.
